D: Elsa follows a mysterious voice into an enchanted forest to learn the truth about Arendelle's past.
P: Serve the snacks when the family plays charades on game night.
S: the family charades game in the castle
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate and a pinch of salt, set and broken into clusters, served in big bowls.
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, spooned onto toasted sourdough with shaved parmesan.
Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey and thyme until sticky, served with a whipped feta dip.
M: Salmon, white fish and prawns simmered in a creamy broth with leek, potato and dill, served with rye bread.
the Northuldra camp in the forest
Lamb shoulder rubbed with juniper, garlic and rosemary, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, with roasted root vegetables.
W: Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, topped with whipped cream and blueberries, dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: Kristoff trying to propose to Anna
Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, orange peel and cloves, ladled into mugs.

s.note: the family charades game in the castle
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 30g melted butter. Spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate and drizzle all over, then sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Leave to set for 30 minutes and break into clusters for game night.

Toss 500g baby carrots with honey, thyme and oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until sticky. Whip 150g feta with 150g Greek yoghurt until smooth. Serve the carrots warm around the dip. Keep one aside for a snowman's nose.

m.how: Soften 2 sliced leeks in butter, add 400g diced potatoes and 1L water and simmer until tender. Add 300g salmon and 300g white fish chunks and 200g green prawns and cook 5 minutes. Stir in cream and dill and serve with rye bread.

w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream and blueberries and dust with icing sugar like frost.

d.note: Kristoff trying to propose to Anna
d.how: Pour 1.5L apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, a few strips of orange peel and 4 whole cloves. Warm gently for 15 minutes. Ladle into mugs and serve to anyone who has been out in the cold with a reindeer.
